from pathlib import Path

    \"Shopping\": \"Amazon|Best Buy|Home Depot|Target|REI|Barnes & Noble|Old Navy|IKEA|Steam\",

    \"Entertainment\": \"Spotify Concert|AMC Theatres|Bowl-O-Rama|Ticketmaster\",
    \"Local transport / parking\": \"Lyft|Uber|City Parking Authority\",
    \"Car maintenance\": \"Jiffy Lube\",
    \"Travel\": \"Delta Air Lines|Airport Parking|Marriott|Hertz Rental Car\",
    \"Uncategorized\": \"Zelle Payment|ATM Cash Withdrawal|Venmo - Sam|PayPal Transfer\",
}
categories = {m: c for c, merchants in groups.items() for m in merchants.split(\"|\")}
date_pattern = re.compile(
    r\"2026-\\d{2}-\\d{2}|\\b\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}(?:/26)?\\b|\"
    r\"\\b(?:06|07|08)-\\d{2}\\b|\\b(?:June|Jun\\.?|July|Jul\\.?|August|Aug\\.?)\\s+\\d{1,2}\\b\"
)
def parse_date(value):
    if value.startswith(\"2026-\"):
        return date.fromisoformat(value)
    if value[0].isdigit():
        parts = re.split(r\"[/\\-]\", value)
        return date(2026, int(parts[0]), int(parts[1]))
    month_name, day = value.replace(\".\", \"\").split()
    return date(2026, {\"Jun\": 6, \"Jul\": 7, \"Aug\": 8}[month_name[:3]], int(day))

rows, failures, metadata = [], [], []
for line_number, raw in enumerate(Path(\"personal_expenses.txt\").read_text().splitlines(), 1):
    if not raw.strip():
        continue
    match = date_pattern.search(raw)
    if not match:
        (metadata if raw.startswith((\"misc expenses\", \"(started\")) else failures).append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    remainder = raw[:match.start()] + raw[match.end():]
    amount_match = re.search(r\"(?<"'!'"\\S)-?\\"'$?'"\\d+\\.\\d{2}(?=\\s*\\)?\\s*"'$)", remainder)
    if not amount_match:
        failures.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    amount = Decimal(amount_match.group().replace("$", ""))
    merchant = (remainder[:amount_match.start()] + remainder[amount_match.end():]).strip(" -:|,()")
    merchant = re.sub(r"''^Return processed'"\\s*-\\s*\", \"\", merchant).strip(\" -:|,()\")
    if merchant not in categories:
        failures.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    rows.append((line_number, parse_date(match.group()), merchant, amount, categories[merchant]))

clean, duplicates, seen = [], [], {}
for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda r: (r[1], r[0])):
    key = row[1:4]
    if key in seen:
        duplicates.append((row, seen[key]))
    else:
        seen[key] = row[0]
        clean.append(row)

totals = defaultdict(lambda: Decimal(\"0.00\"))
for _, day, merchant, amount, category in clean:
    totals[category, day.month] += amount

print(\"COUNTS\", {\"parsed\": len(rows), \"retained\": len(clean), \"failures\": failures, \"metadata\": metadata})
print(\"MONTHLY\")
for category in groups:
    print(category, *[str(totals[category, month]) for month in (6, 7, 8)], sep=\" | \")
month_totals = {m: sum((totals[c, m] for c in groups), Decimal(\"0.00\")) for m in (6, 7, 8)}
print(\"TOTAL\", month_totals)
print(\"KNOWN_CATEGORY_TOTAL\", {m: month_totals[m] - totals[\"Uncategorized\", m] for m in (6, 7, 8)})
print(\"BUDGET: actual, target, actual-minus-target\")
for category, target in ((\"Eating out / coffee\", Decimal(\"260\")), (\"Shopping\", Decimal(\"1200\"))):
    for m in (6, 7, 8):
        actual = totals[category, m]
        print(category, m, actual, target, actual - target)
print(\"DUPLICATES\", duplicates)
print(\"REFUNDS\", [r for r in clean if r[3] < 0])
print(\"UNCATEGORIZED\", [r for r in clean if r[4] == \"Uncategorized\"])
print(\"LARGEST CHANGES: ranked by absolute dollars\")
changes = [(totals[c, m] - totals[c, m-1], c, m-1, m) for c in groups for m in (7, 8)]
for change in sorted(changes, key=lambda x: abs(x[0]), reverse=True):
    print(change)
print(\"TOTAL CHANGES\", {m: month_totals[m] - month_totals[m-1] for m in (7, 8)})
print(\"TRAVEL COMPONENTS\", [r for r in clean if r[4] == \"Travel\"])
